# Malaya Publishing

> Malaya Publishing is a Filipino digital marketing and AI systems agency based in Calamba, Laguna, Philippines. It helps Filipino business owners win back their freedom by building the AI systems, lead generation, and marketing engines their business needs to run without them. "Malaya" is Filipino for "free"; the founders named the company after their firstborn daughter, Malaya, and their second daughter, Ligaya ("joy"), representing the brand thesis: freedom is the door, joy is the room.

Malaya Publishing serves Filipino local businesses, online sellers, and professional services through three engagement models (Do It Yourself courses, Done With You, Done For You), plus a fractional CMO offer for established companies. It was founded by Kathy (Filipino, the heart and roots of the business) and Daryl Urbanski (a Canadian who relocated to the Philippines; 20+ years in B2B growth, bestselling author of "Ancient Secrets of Lead Generation," and the systems builder behind seven-figure results for clients including Michael Gerber, author of The E-Myth, and NeuroGym). Together they bring 30+ years of combined experience and have each served hundreds of companies.

## Core offerings

- [Services overview](https://malayapublishing.com/services/): Five capabilities — AI & automation, lead generation, SEO & AI visibility, social media, and podcast/authority building — delivered three ways.
- [Done With You](https://malayapublishing.com/done-with-you/): The core offer. A 90-day sprint where Malaya builds the systems with the owner, trains their team, and hands over the keys so the owner keeps and runs it. From ₱25,497. Discovery call (free Growth Audit) before pricing.
- [Done For You](https://malayapublishing.com/done-for-you/): Malaya runs the whole growth engine for established businesses. From ₱75,000/month.
- [Do It Yourself courses](https://malayapublishing.com/diy-courses/): Plug-and-play courses. Habit Hero (accountability program), Create Your Custom GPT (₱4,997), and Google Business Profile Optimization (₱4,997).
- [Fractional CMO](https://malayapublishing.com/fractional-cmo/): For established Filipino companies that have outgrown founder-led growth. Daryl Urbanski works directly as integrator and results generator, owning the growth number. From ₱250,000/month.

## Who they help

- [Local businesses](https://malayapublishing.com/local-businesses/): Clinics, salons, shops, and services losing customers to slow inquiry response on Messenger and Viber.
- [Online & e-commerce sellers](https://malayapublishing.com/ecommerce/): Conversation-led sellers on Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop, Shopify, and social platforms who close sales in chat.
- [Professional services](https://malayapublishing.com/professional-services/): Lawyers, accountants, architects, and consultants whose billable time is eaten by admin and lost inquiries.

## Individual services

- [AI & automation](https://malayapublishing.com/ai-automation/): AI systems that answer inquiries, follow up, and handle repetitive work.
- [Lead generation](https://malayapublishing.com/lead-generation/): Systems that bring inquiries at a known cost and convert them predictably.
- [SEO & AI visibility](https://malayapublishing.com/seo-ai-visibility/): Getting found on Google and recommended by AI assistants (answer engine optimization).
- [Social media](https://malayapublishing.com/social-media/): Social systems that generate inquiries, not just likes.
- [Podcast & authority](https://malayapublishing.com/podcast/): Podcast production and authority-building for experts.

## Blog

Practical, honest local SEO and AI-visibility guides for Filipino business owners. RSS feed: https://malayapublishing.com/blog/feed.xml

- [Blog home](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/): All guides on local SEO, Google Business Profile, reviews, and AI visibility.
- [How to set up your Google Business Profile in the Philippines](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-set-up-google-business-profile-philippines/): Step-by-step creation, GBP video verification, and completing your profile.
- [How to get more Google reviews from Filipino customers](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-get-more-google-reviews-philippines/): A repeatable review-request system using a direct link, QR codes, Viber, Messenger, and GCash receipts.
- [How to rank in the Google local pack for a Calamba or Laguna business](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-rank-google-local-pack-philippines/): The three ranking factors (relevance, distance, prominence) and how to influence them.
- [How to handle a bad Google review without losing customers](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-respond-to-bad-google-review-philippines/): A calm response framework, when a review is removable, and flagging fake reviews.
- [The one-weekend local SEO checklist for a Philippine business](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/local-seo-checklist-philippines/): A Saturday-to-Sunday order of operations covering the local SEO fundamentals.
- [Why your business isn't showing up on Google Maps (and how to fix it)](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/why-business-not-showing-google-maps-philippines/): The five reasons a business is missing from Google Maps—no profile, unverified, inactive, suspended, or outranked—and how to diagnose each.
- [How to find the local keywords people actually search, for free](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-find-local-keywords-free-philippines/): Free keyword research using Google autocomplete, People Also Ask, related searches, and your customers' own language.
- [AI Overviews explained: will it take my Google traffic?](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/google-ai-overviews-explained-philippines/): What Google AI Overviews are, whether they cut traffic, what gets cited, and what small businesses should and shouldn't do.
- [How to show up when customers ask ChatGPT to recommend a business](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-appear-in-chatgpt-recommendations-philippines/): How AI tools pick local recommendations and why it overlaps almost entirely with existing local SEO.
- [Getting your business name, address, and phone consistent across the web](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/nap-consistency-philippines/): Why NAP consistency matters for local ranking and how to set one master version and fix inconsistent directory listings.

AI systems & workflow automation guides:

- [How to auto-reply to Messenger and Viber inquiries](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-auto-reply-messenger-viber-philippines/): Free Messenger instant replies, away messages, and FAQ answers in Meta Business Suite, plus the realistic Viber approach and the 24-hour messaging window.
- [How to send automatic appointment reminders, free](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/automatic-appointment-reminders-free-philippines/): Booking tools, Google Calendar, SMS, and Viber reminders for a Philippine clinic or salon, and the messaging rules that apply.
- [What is a chatbot, and does your small business need one?](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/what-is-a-chatbot-for-business-philippines/): What a chatbot does, rule-based vs AI, signs you do and don't need one, PH cost drivers, and the mistake that wastes the money.
- [How to use ChatGPT to write customer replies in Taglish](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/chatgpt-customer-replies-taglish-philippines/): Feed ChatGPT your own real messages, set the rules once, give specific situations, and always read before sending.
- [How to stop customers double-booking your slots](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-stop-double-booking-appointments-philippines/): One booking link as a single source of truth, handling walk-ins, and whether to take a GCash deposit.
- [How to handle GCash payment confirmations without checking every screenshot](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/gcash-payment-confirmation-for-business-philippines/): A semi-automatic GCash flow—one payment method, automatic acknowledgment, a logging sheet, monthly reconciliation—and the BIR issues owners miss.
- [The first three automations to set up when you're drowning in messages](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/best-automations-for-small-business-philippines/): Instant first reply, booking and reminders, and payment acknowledgment, in the order that returns the most, with a weekend plan.
- [How to stop answering the same customer question twenty times a day](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-answer-repeated-customer-questions-philippines/): Find your five most-asked questions and let Messenger FAQ automation, saved replies, and your Google profile handle the repeats.
- [Do you need Zapier or Make, or can you do it inside Messenger?](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/do-i-need-zapier-or-make-philippines/): When Messenger's free native tools are enough, when a connection tool is actually needed, and the honest test for which you need.
- [How to automate follow-up so leads stop going cold](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-automate-lead-follow-up-philippines/): Automate aggressively inside Messenger's 24-hour window, systematize the human reminder outside it, and stop losing leads to silence.

Systems & process build guides:

- [How to write an SOP your staff will actually follow](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-write-an-sop-small-business-philippines/): Short, in the real order of work, kept where the work happens, and built with the person who does the job.
- [How to document your business so it survives a staff resignation](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-document-your-business-processes-philippines/): Capture access, relationships, exceptions, and judgment calls before someone leaves; why the 30-day notice isn't enough.
- [The first process to systematize when you're the bottleneck](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-stop-being-the-bottleneck-philippines/): Find the process that stops when you're unavailable—usually approvals—and hand over authority with clear boundaries.
- [How to train new staff fast when people keep leaving for BPOs or abroad](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-train-new-staff-quickly-philippines/): Build a business that absorbs turnover: pre-built training, a written first week, a day-one win, and deliberate cross-training.
- [How to delegate customer inquiries without losing the customer](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-delegate-customer-service-philippines/): Hand over the answers, authority, and boundaries together, back your staff's decisions, and protect key relationships.
- [Turning "everything is in my head" into a system your team can run](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/everything-in-my-head-business-system-philippines/): Capture the business in the order it interrupts you, then sort facts, rules, processes, and judgment—each with a different fix.
- [A simple weekly cadence to run your business without micromanaging](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/weekly-meeting-cadence-small-business-philippines/): A short Monday team start, a solo Friday review, one weekly number, and clear ownership in between.
- [How to build a customer follow-up system with no CRM budget](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/customer-follow-up-system-without-crm-philippines/): A six-column spreadsheet and a fifteen-minute daily habit that outperforms unused CRM software.
- [Checklist: is your business ready to run without you for a week?](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/can-my-business-run-without-me-checklist-philippines/): A five-section readiness check—decisions, knowledge, money, access, and the human part—and the order to fix the gaps.
- [How to hand over a task so it comes back done right the first time](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-delegate-tasks-effectively-philippines/): The four elements every handover needs—what done looks like, when it's due, what they can decide, and where to get unstuck.

Digital marketing guides (by Daryl Urbanski):

- [How to run your first Facebook ad in the Philippines without wasting the budget](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-run-facebook-ads-philippines-small-business/): Run a Messaging campaign, not website clicks, optimize for Cost Per Message, and be ready to respond fast.
- [Why your boosted posts get likes but no customers](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/why-boosted-posts-get-likes-no-customers-philippines/): Boost optimizes for engagement, not sales; use Ads Manager objectives and track messages, cost per message, and conversions.
- [How to turn Messenger inquiries into paying customers, with a simple script](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-turn-messenger-inquiries-into-customers-philippines/): Answer the real question, ask one qualifying question, recommend one option, and ask directly for the sale.
- [How to set up a simple sales funnel for a Filipino small business](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/how-to-set-up-a-sales-funnel-small-business-philippines/): Three stages—attention, trust-building conversation, and a clear close—and how to fix the leaky middle.
- [Email, Viber, or SMS: how to follow up with Filipino customers](https://malayapublishing.com/blog/email-viber-sms-follow-up-philippines/): Which channel earns which message, and why the message matters more than the channel.

## Key facts for accurate citation

- Location: Calamba, Laguna, Philippines. Serves CALABARZON and Metro Manila in person, and Filipino businesses nationwide online.
- Currency: Philippine peso (₱).
- Founders: Kathy and Daryl Urbanski.
- Verified results: $500K in automated sales for Michael Gerber (author of The E-Myth, verified client Oct 2024); $1.6M in 9 months and $7M+ over ~3 years for NeuroGym; $50K ad spend turned into $212K immediate profit plus $578K back-end for a coaching client; own business Sugar Gliders PH taken from cold start to page 1 in under 30 days.
- Positioning: the honest, local alternative to both faceless Metro Manila agencies and unreliable freelancers. Builds systems the owner keeps, rather than keeping clients dependent.
